01. Each open position has specific attachment requirements in order to be considered by the hiring committee. If the attachment directions are not followed, your application will not be considered. The required attachments for this position are: • Cover Letter; • Resume; • Reference List ; • Unofficial Transcripts ; • Diversity Statement; Have you attached the correct required documents to your application? Options: Yes | No
Minimum one year experience working in a CA State Licensed preschool or toddler center based program working 3 hours per day as an employee, laboratory student or combination of the two
Possess or obtain current First Aid and CPR Certification;
Possess a current California driver’s license;

Minimum 24 ECE and general education units equal to an Associate of Arts Degree 12 units of ECE must include the core courses including child/human growth & development, child/family/community or child family relations; and program/curriculum. Applicant must have a minimum of three semester units or four quarter units in each of the core areas.
Hold or willing to apply for a Child Development Permit at the Associate Teacher level or above;
Must be enrolled and maintain continued enrollment in coursework leading to an AA/AS or BA/BS degree in Child Development, other related field or a BA/BS in any other discipline
Completion of Laboratory or Supervised Field Experience equal to ECE 216;
Experience working in a college ECE laboratory school.
Support the Instructional Assistant/Lead Teacher in all aspects of the classroom environment;
Participate in planning weekly/monthly lessons, snack menus and classroom activities;
Be a role model for students, children, and families;
Ongoing role modeling and demonstration of Developmentally, Individually, and Culturally Appropriate Practices;
Assist in maintaining a safe and healthy environment;
Willing to lead in the absence of the Instructional Assistant/Lead Teacher;
Be a team player with all center staff and activities;
Support cooperative relationships with Instructional Assistant/Lead Teacher, Staff, Parents, Students and Faculty;
Willingness to participate in yearly rotation from toddler room through the preschool classrooms, practicing continuity by rotating with same groups of children;
Participate in assessing and conferencing with families about their children; and
Perform other related duties as required.

12 units of ECE must include the core courses including child/human growth & development, child/family/community or child family relations; and program/curriculum. Applicant must have a minimum of three semester units or four quarter units in each of the core areas.
Current technologies, personal computer, and associated office software such as word processing, spreadsheet, presentation, and/or database software;
Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the performance of duties; and
Correct usage of English, grammar, spelling, punctuation, and vocabulary; and

Demonstrate a sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds of staff and students and of staff and students with physical and learning disabilities.
District policies and procedures.
Read and comprehend printed matter and text and data on computer monitors;
See for the purpose of reading children’s books, laws and codes, rules and policies and other printed matter;
Hear and understand speech at normal levels;
Understand and carry out oral and written directions;
Sit or stand for extended periods of time both indoors and outdoors;
Bend, twist, push and pull, stoop, kneel, crawl, and climb;
Lift and/or carry 50 pounds for the purpose of picking up and lifting a child;
Sit on floor and/or small tables and chairs;
Exert manual dexterity sufficient for keyboard and other office equipment operation; and
Perform other duties as requested.
Current TB Clearance;
Up to date with all required immunizations according to the Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing; must include Measles and Pertussis, Flu preferred.
Knowledge of philosophies of the Program for Infant and Toddler Care.
Communicate intelligibly and effectively via speech, telephone, written correspondence, and/or email;
To have completed or have the ability to take a 3-unit infant and toddler course (as required by licensing for work with infants and toddlers) within one year of employment.
